scope: Eight unchanged legacy workloads freshly compared at current source versus original 0.4. All observations and flags retained; no performance exception is accepted.
control_profile_role: All ring_* profiles are handwritten fixture substrate operations, including capture, append, replay, restore and promotion; none is subtracted from a library result.

limits: Retain every observation. Thresholds are review flags, not equivalence or statistical acceptance tests. p99 reported without a new gate. No baseline subtraction, noise normalization, outlier removal, or changing workloads.

The complete per-profile rows and all raw processes, fixtures, locks and sixteen measured binaries are archived.
